equivalence_note: No daily cash statement (DTS analog) in New Zealand. Daily footprint = desk derivation autonomous_flow_daily (Layer 1); weekly = NZDM tender results (issuance drain on T+3 settlement) and the monthly tender schedule (known drain dates); monthly = R3 Crown settlement accounts (14th) and D10 government cash influence (end of following month); Treasury monthly financial statements ~6 weeks lag = confirmation. Weight 0.15 | v0.2: NZDM HTML result pages at 14:35 NZT (T-bills T+1, bonds T+3) are the primary weekly source; residual daily flow is coincident/noisy with a reconciliation band

mmt_note.label: MMT note
mmt_note.text: Crown spending credits settlement accounts (creates net financial assets); taxes debit them; NZGB and T-bill tenders drain settlement cash on settlement without changing the private sector's net financial assets — they swap reserves for bonds. New Zealand publishes no daily Crown cash figure: the desk reads the Crown through the residual movement of settlement cash after RBNZ operations, and confirms it monthly with D10 / R3.
